text:
liam: Quick sync — proposal to deprecate legacy flag store (kv1) and switch all runtime flags to typed schema v2.
liam: Goals: clear rollback path, telemetry gating for each rollout cohort, console UX for migration, and minimal API churn.
maria: +1 on typed schema. what's the rollback plan if a flag regresses production metrics?
liam: rollback plan outline: 1) server-side flag switch (instant) 2) auto-fallback to `legacy_variant` if errors spike >5% for 5m 3) retention of old keys for 7 days for replay.
jamal: telemetry gating — can we avoid full 100% release until we see no regressions on 3 metrics (p99 latency, error rate, model-fallbacks)? Suggest sample-based rollout: 1%, 5%, 25%, 100% with checkpoints.
kat: Console concern: product teams expect to see cohort-level breakdowns and a one-click rollback in the UI. We should add a "preview in console" mode that shows effective config for a given cohort id.
liam: agreed. UX wishlist: preview-by-cohort, diff between current and pending config, and a "dry-run" toggle that routes X% traffic to v2 but doesn't persist state changes to downstream systems.
suhail: API compatibility question: will v2 schema be backward compatible? If not, we need a shim in the runtime that reads both formats during transition. Also add deprecation header in responses: `X-Flag-Format: v1-deprecated` so clients can log usage.
jamal: +1 on shim. Also telemetry: emit `flag_migration_cohort` and `flag_eval_source` tags. We need these in the routing traces so SRE can correlate spool/backpressure events with rollout stages.
ops-bot: deploybot: checklist for rollout -> config migration scripts tested in staging, migration dry-run completed, telemetry hooks instrumented, alert thresholds set.
maria: about quotas/routing: some legacy flags are used in routing decisions (route-by-cost). Changing format must not change evaluation semantics. We should create unit tests that exercise ranking/order and default fallthrough behaviour.
liam: agreed. I'll add a test matrix: boolean, percentage, weighted buckets, nested conditions. Also create a short lint rule that fails a migration PR if default is missing.
kat: on console: for deprecation flow, show a banner on flag detail page: "This flag is using legacy storage. Migrate to typed schema v2 by Nov 15." Add a migration assistant modal that suggests equivalent typed structure.
suhail: migration assistant should offer `curl` snippet for bulk migration. Example: `curl -X POST /internal/flags/migrate -d '{"from":"kv1","to":"schema_v2","dry_run":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'`
liam: will draft the API. PS — need to decide whether the rollout policy language adds `cohort_id` as first-class filter. Jamal, Kat: any objections to cohort-based scoping field?
jamal: fine with `cohort_id`, but suggest we keep `sample_rate` and `seed` deterministic to prevent cohort drift. Add `stable_hash` function in runtime.
kat: fine. UX will show cohort preview and seed control. But surface warning: changing `seed` reassigns users to cohorts.
maria: can we wire telemetry to the dashboard so PMs can see regressions per-cohort? Ideally a per-flag dashboard with cohort toggles.
liam: yes — telemetry team needs a small contract: `flag.name`, `flag.version`, `cohort_id`, `sample_rate`, `metric.name`, `metric.value`, `checkpoint`. We'll add a lightweight eval hook to emit these.
suhail: compatibility note: add header `X-Flag-Version` and `X-Flag-Cohort` to routed requests for easier tracing.
liam: next steps I/O: I'll open a design doc with API sketch + migration scripts. Kat, can you mock console screens? Jamal and Suhail, can you prototype shim + telemetry events? Maria, please write the test matrix. Ops-bot: can you add rollout checklist to runbook?
ops-bot: done — created checklist card in #eng-oncall and linked to this thread.
kat: I'll have mocks by EOD Wednesday.
jamal: I'll spike a shim PR and basic telemetry by Friday.
suhail: I'll add headers and sample `curl` in the doc.
maria: starting tests tomorrow.
liam: thanks all. small ask: keep migration as opt-in toggles in console for first two weeks. we won't auto-migrate.
jamal: :thumbsup:
kat: :eyes:
liam: will follow up with doc link and timeline.
